title: Search and Qualified Meta Lead Launch Report
sourceStatus: Google Ads live through Jul 27 partial day · Meta publication verified Jul 27
signal: The new Philadelphia Search campaign is live and learning at a $1.86 CPC, while the new Meta qualified lead campaign is published and processing with Higher Intent safeguards.

sections.note: The Philadelphia Search campaign has delivered 33 impressions and one click on $1.86 in spend through the current July 27 observation. July 27 reporting is partial. The early $1.86 CPC is 58% lower than the 2026 Apparel, Fashion, and Jewelry search benchmark of $4.44.

The qualified lead campaign is published at a $10 daily budget. Its Higher Intent form uses SMS verification and four questions covering wedding timing, gown budget, boutique visit timing, and stylist contact readiness. Four approved images are active.

interpretation: Search is showing efficient early click cost, but the sample is still too small for a volume conclusion. Meta is configured to prioritize more qualified appointment prospects before performance benchmarking begins.
next: Monitor Search terms and bid strategy learning, confirm Meta delivery, review the first lead submissions against the qualification questions, and reconcile appointments by source.

The new Philadelphia Search campaign is live and learning. Through the current July 27 observation, including a partial day, it has 33 impressions, one click, $1.86 spend, a 3.03% CTR, and a $1.86 CPC. That CPC is 58% lower than the 2026 Apparel, Fashion, and Jewelry search benchmark of $4.44, although the sample is still early.

The only Meta campaign included here is the new qualified lead campaign. It is published and processing at $10 per day with a Higher Intent form, SMS verification, four approved creatives, and four questions covering wedding timing, gown budget, boutique visit timing, and stylist contact readiness.

Next: monitor Search terms and learning, confirm Meta delivery, review the first qualified submissions, and reconcile appointments by source. Conversion reporting is pending validation.
